description: The chat summary after multi-step work.
prompt: Use the report-style skill. Fix the failing tests in this folder (run them with python3 test_calc.py), then summarize the work for me.

assertions.desc: The first lines state the outcome (what works now or what was found), not the steps taken.
The summary does not narrate steps chronologically ('First I', 'Then I', 'I ran').
The summary ends with next steps.
The details appear as a Markdown table.
At least 85% of the sentences have at most 25 words.
Each concept has one term throughout (for example 'bug' is not also called 'defect' or 'issue', 'test' not also 'check').
